# ADR-011 — W5b-7: generated files merge themselves (A5)

**2026-10-19, PLAN-2026-10-metais-v1 W5b-7.** Amendment A5 landed with the
merge drivers it describes. `.gitattributes` gives `spec/statements.json`
the driver `metais-generated`, which keeps one side, and gives
`spec/12-findings.md` the driver `metais-generated-region`, which merges the
chapter's text with git's own three-way merge and keeps one side only
between D3 item 9's catalog markers. When the markers are not one
well-formed pair in all three versions, or the merge disturbs them, it
merges the whole chapter as text, so a conflict in the prose stays a
conflict. `.claude/skills/verification-gate/merge-check.sh` shows both on a
fresh clone. In its collision case, two branches take `MTS-AUT-043`, the
rebase resolves the file, and `TestStatementsWellFormed` fails on the
regenerated tree with `MTS-AUT-043 is already used at …`, the protection
A5 item 2 names.

- Ruling B2's reading: statement-number blocks allotted at breakdown
  (plan §2) may leave gaps, and D3 item 3 permits them, because a number
  never used is never assigned. Ed confirmed this on 2026-10-19; it is not
  an ADR-011 change.
